  replicas: 3
  selector:

      app: checkoutservice

    metadata:
      labels:
        app: checkoutservice

      serviceAccountName: checkoutservice

        fsGroup: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000

        - name: server
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false

              drop:
                - ALL

            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          image: us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/google-samples/microservices-demo/checkoutservice:v0.10.3
          ports:
          - containerPort: 5050
          readinessProbe:
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            grpc:
              port: 5050
          livenessProbe:
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            grpc:
              port: 5050
          env:
          - name: PORT

          - name: PRODUCT_CATALOG_SERVICE_ADDR

          - name: SHIPPING_SERVICE_ADDR

              cpu: 100m

              memory: 128Mi
